nodes.summary: Let $L/K$ be a finite-dimensional Galois extension and let $\sigma$ be a $K$-algebra automorphism of $L$ that generates its Galois group, that is, every $K$-algebra automorphism of $L$ is an integer power of $\sigma$. If $x \in L$ satisfies $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}(x) = 0$, then there is $y \in L$ with $\sigma(y) - y = x$.
nodes.title: Additive Hilbert 90, pointwise form

nodes.summary: Let $L/K$ be a finite-dimensional Galois extension and let $\sigma$ be a $K$-algebra automorphism of $L$ that generates its Galois group, that is, every $K$-algebra automorphism of $L$ is an integer power of $\sigma$. Then the kernel of the trace $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K} \colon L \to K$ equals the image of the $K$-linear map $\sigma - 1 \colon L \to L$, $y \mapsto \sigma(y) - y$.
nodes.title: Additive Hilbert 90 for cyclic extensions

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

proved.label: proved
